name: Animals
overview: Scripture reveals that God created animals with intentionality and care, bringing forth every living creature after its kind, including great whales, cattle, and winged fowl, and declared His creation good (Genesis 1:21, 1:24-25). God granted man dominion over all animals, highlighting humanity's unique role in relation to creation (Genesis 1:26). Furthermore, animals are living souls to whom God has given vegetation for food, demonstrating His provision for their sustenance (Genesis 1:30). The naming of animals by Adam underscores their distinct identities within God's orderly creation (Genesis 2:19).
